scope: Actual existing-thread wake integration; new devtool and mocked tests only
configuration: Private owned mode0600 local ignored/outside-Git JSON only; exact schema1 allowed fields schema,mode,expiresUTC,thread,repo,checkpoint,codex. No secrets. Canonical UUID and timezone expiry mandatory only for unattended. Use an actual codex executable absolute path. Keep config/lock/state local; never commit them.
safety: No exec/new coordinator/new worker/new identity, goal mutation, source change or QA dispatch.

Only exact configured existing thread receives the fixed recovery-health prompt through codex queue --resume, argv without shell. Prompt explicitly refuses human handoff/paused/completed/actual external blockers and directs verification before authorized internal repair.
Exclusive nonblocking flock held for entire watcher; second watcher refuses before any queue call.
Private atomic persisted pre-dispatch attempt reservation limits repeated warnings, failures, timeouts and process crashes.
Any warning including exit0 is unconfirmed; every attempt retains status wake-unconfirmed and restartVerified false. Clean exit0 means only queueAccepted, never actual running or restart.
Default handoff/expired never queue. Config loaded on every tick and rechecked before cooldown reservation.
coverage: fresh checkpoint with actual terminal report
limitations: Installation and scheduling are intentionally not performed; user is working remotely and current handoff stays disarmed.
Queue acceptance is not proof of actual agent continuation. Existing goal and human instructions remain authoritative.
Must be explicitly armed later under existing user authorization with an exact thread, expiration and ignored private config.
